label: Bible Study
prompt: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you _____.
verse: And ye shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.
note: Truth and freedom, permanently linked — quoted on university walls everywhere.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: All _____ is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
verse: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
note: 'Inspiration' here is literally 'God-breathed' — the Book has breath in it.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And be not _____ to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
verse: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
note: Conformed is the world's mold; transformed is God's renovation — one letter swap, whole different life.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Though thou exalt thyself as the _____, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the LORD.
verse: Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down, saith the LORD.
note: The shortest Old Testament book, aimed at Edom's cliff-top pride: no nest is above God's reach.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Which in time past was to thee _____, but now profitable to thee and to me:
verse: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable, but now profitable to thee and to me:
note: A pun on Onesimus, whose name means 'useful': once unprofitable, now profitable.
